verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for an AI observability platform, so the axis applies. The pack never states an open-source license for Braintrust or any of its components. The GitHub items show public SDK example code (braintrust-sdk-javascript) but no license terms, and the self-hosting docs describe customer-run data storage with a Braintrust-managed platform rather than open source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
